facts.text: Languages spoken here include English, French and Mauritian Creole.
It is a coastal country in Eastern Africa.

culture.text: Mauritian street snacks reflect varied cultural connections, including samosas and gateaux piments related to Indian vadai.

food.name: Rougaille
food.text: A tomato-and-onion preparation commonly served with meat or seafood.
